verifications.claim: Artemis II is conducting a 10-day crewed flight test around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Artemis II (April 1–11, 2026) was a crewed lunar flyby mission... Mission duration9 days, 1 hour, 32 minutes and 15 seconds"; "a 10-day mission around the Moon"; "roughly 10-day flight"; "10-day trip around the Moon"
verifications.reasoning: R1 explicitly states it was a ~10-day crewed lunar flyby test mission; multiple sources confirm 10-day duration and lunar flyby/test nature.

verifications.claim: Artemis II marks the first human mission to deep space in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972"; "first time humans have headed to the Moon since Apollo 17 in 1972"; "first crewed moon mission since 1972"; "first time in over 50 years"
verifications.reasoning: R1 and others directly state first crewed deep space (beyond LEO) since Apollo 17 (1972-2026=54 years, over 50).

verifications.claim: Artemis II had a successful launch on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Launch dateApril 1, 2026, 22:35:12 UTC"; "Artemis II lifts off... on April 1, 2026"; "launched... on April 1"; "At 6:35 p.m. EDT, the Artemis 2 mission successfully lifted off"
verifications.reasoning: R1 and launch coverage sources confirm successful launch on exact date April 1, 2026.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew consists of four persons.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Crew size4"; "NASA launches 4 astronauts"; "Four astronauts"; "4 astronauts"; "crew of four astronauts"
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly state crew of four astronauts.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew is verifying the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Immediately after main-engine cutoff, Koch and Hansen unstrapped from their seats to set up and test essential life support systems aboard the spacecraft, including the water dispenser, firefighting masks, and toilet. All systems checked out"; "evaluated life support and other critical spacecraft systems"
verifications.reasoning: R1 details crew testing life support systems (water, masks, toilet) in high Earth orbit.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew is performing manual piloting tests in high-Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Over approximately 70 minutes, Glover... took manual control... performed a series of maneuvers to evaluate handling qualities... first time a crewed spacecraft had entered a high Earth orbit"; "pilot Victor Glover... hand-flying Integrity... proximity operations demonstration"
verifications.reasoning: R1 describes manual piloting/proximity ops demo by Glover in high Earth orbit; R2 confirms.
